name: Homebrew Options
_note: Homebrew, hand-authored from published sources — not generated by scripts/convert.py. The Predator is a Warlock subclass from D&D Wiki (https://www.dandwiki.com/wiki/The_Predator_(5e_Subclass)), CC-BY-SA 3.0. It leans on content it does not ship: the Warlock class and 13 spells. See `requires` — Fieldbook reports any of them that isn't loaded rather than failing quietly.

features.name: Pact of Tooth and Claw
features.description:
3rd-level Pact Boon option.
Your patron has bestowed upon you the tooth and fangs of the hunter. As an action you can alter your body to create a natural weapon, worthy of the hunt. This weapon can take a variety of forms, from a large maw of razor-sharp teeth like a shark, the deadly talons of a graceful owl, or even the stinger tail of the scorpion.
Regardless of the form, it deals 1d6 slashing, piercing or bludgeoning damage (you choose when you gain this boon), uses your Strength or Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls, and counts as a simple weapon with which you are proficient.
If you already have a natural weapon from your race when you take this boon (such as a Lizardfolk's Bite, a Tabaxi's Cat's Claws or a Centaur's Hooves), then its damage die becomes a d6 (unless it's already higher), you gain the option of using your Strength or Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls, and it now counts as a simple weapon that you are proficient with.
In addition, your natural weapon counts as magical for the purposes of overcoming resistances and immunities to nonmagical attacks and damage.

features.name: Improved Natural Weapon
features.description:
Prerequisite: Pact of Tooth and Claw feature
Your natural weapon gains a +1 to attack and damage rolls. At 10th level, this bonus increases to +2.

features.name: Predator's Edge
features.description:
Prerequisite: Pact of Tooth and Claw feature
You gain a climbing and swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

features.name: Hunger Strikes
features.description:
Prerequisite: 5th level, Pact of Tooth and Claw feature
You can attack with your pact natural weapon twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Serpent's Fangs
features.description:
Prerequisite: 5th level, Pact of Tooth and Claw feature
Once per turn, when you hit a creature with your pact's natural weapon, you can force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature takes an additional 2d6 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage and isn't poisoned.

features.name: Chimeric Reach
features.description:
Prerequisite: 5th level, Pact of Tooth and Claw feature
The reach of your pact natural weapon increases by 5 feet.

features.name: Tactics of the Pack
features.description:
Prerequisite: 7th level, Pact of Tooth and Claw feature
You have advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated (this invocation does not stack with the Pack Tactics trait).
